repository_commit_note: The commit that adds this kernel; this provenance record sits on top of it, so the branch head that ships it has a later hash.
scope: Ascend 950DT GemmW4A16FwdOp: all 15 manifest workload cases (decode batch 1 at three hidden sizes, a long-K streaming case, batched decode, one prefill tile, and the single-/multi-tile compile checks) with the manifest's marlin-layout INT4 packing. Not a public performance receipt. The op runs a fused vector-to-L1 path when the call has one row tile and the two-pass form above it.

campaign.metric: arithmetic mean of raw ffts device execution interval unions
campaign.reason: Task-private protocol adapter: one profiler window carries all 25 calls instead of one window per call. The eviction and the parsed statistic are unchanged; the public default-clock receipt and the host-wide reservation are still unavailable.
campaign.workspace: Task acceptance workspace, kept outside the repository.
campaign.stage_protocol: The fused path is timed end to end; the two-pass path also reports its stages under the same window, and they sum to its forward time.

baseline.vendor_ops: torch_npu npu_weight_quant_batchmatmul (A16W4 with per-group scales), measured in the same round on the same shapes: the like-for-like baseline for this function.
baseline.deepgemm: DeepGEMM ships no INT4 x FP16 kernel.

replay.result: 15 of 15 manifest cases verified, status passed, source fingerprint unchanged
replay.guard: scripts/npu_guard.py with /dev/davinci0 remapped to /dev/davinci1 for this site
replay.receipt: Task acceptance workspace, kept outside the repository.

verification.tolerances: The shared workload numeric policy through the public runner: Exact(atol=7e-2, rtol=5e-2) against the FP32 dequantized reference.
